authority.decision: This JSON and its two visual references supersede prior Home composition experiments where they conflict, but do not supersede security/privacy/store/Cierre Global/Technical Architecture.

app_icon.concept: Colombian yellow license-plate field with navy PR monogram and teal radar integrated inside the P.

android.note: Create Android launcher/adaptive resources from the approved master/reference without adding a launcher-icon package dependency. Verify masks on circle/squircle/rounded-square.

greeting.rule: Do not add account/cloud/name persistence solely to personalize the greeting. Use local name only if already legitimately available; otherwise fallback.

initial_focus_algorithm: If one or more vehicles are RESTRICTED today with verified/current data, focus the restricted vehicle first.
If several are restricted, prefer the globally active vehicle when it is among them; otherwise deterministic order by vehicle list.
If none is restricted, focus current active vehicle; fallback first vehicle.
vehicle_carousel.persistence_rule: Automatic priority focus must NOT silently overwrite the globally active vehicle. Keep a session Home-focused vehicle id. A deliberate user action such as Start Driving may explicitly promote the focused vehicle if required by existing architecture.
vehicle_carousel.on_page_changed: Update Home-focused vehicle; lower status cards follow focused vehicle.

vehicle_card.image_rule: Use generic local illustrations/silhouettes by body style; never depend on branded manufacturer photography.

plate.format: actual user plate text; visual proportions evoke Colombian plate

restricted_animation.style: soft alternating danger-blue border/glow; siren-inspired but elegant

status_grid.layout: 2 columns on normal mobile width, responsive stack if text scale/width requires

cards.title: SOAT
cards.data: real local obligation when available; otherwise Sin configurar

cards.title: Tecnomecánica
cards.data: real local obligation when available; otherwise Sin configurar

cards.title: Comparendos
cards.data_rule: Never display 0 pendientes unless real verified data exists. Before C14 use Consultar/Próximamente/placeholder state allowed by feature flag.

promo_banner.position: below primary CTA and above bottom nav
promo_banner.height: larger than previous tiny placeholder, approximately 96-132dp depending width
promo_banner.production_visibility_free_1_0: feature-flagged/off until truthful approved content exists
promo_banner.rule: Do not advertise PicoRadar Protect or real-time monitoring as live functionality before it exists.
promo_banner.allowed_current_copy: Más control, más tranquilidad. Próximamente nuevas funciones para ayudarte cada día.

bottom_navigation.apps_style: raised circular teal button / central launch affordance as in approved Home reference

press_motion.apps: raised button moves up 3-5dp and scales ~1.06 then settles; subtle shadow/glow

r01_fix: animated AppBottomNav incl. raised Apps center action
